violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED IN WARMER: CHICKEN NUGGETS AT 119F. OBSERVED ON LINE 1: CHICKEN NUGGETS AT 116F AND 117F OBSERVED ON LINE 2: CHICKEN NUGGETS AT 114F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CDI: CHICKEN NUGGETS IN WARMER PUT IN OVEN TO REHEAT. PIC RE-EDUCATED ON KEEPING FOOD AT 135F WHEN HOT HOLDING.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED IN (5): MOZZARELLA STICKS AT 71F AND 72F AND CUT LETTUCE AT 45F. ITEMS WERE PLACED ON LINE 30MIN PRIOR. OBSERVED ON COLD TABLE ON LINE 2: CUT LETTUCE AT 66F, OPENED CAN OF BEANS AT 65F. BOTH FOR 15MIN. OBSERVED IN (2): COOKED CORN AT 65F (1.5HR).
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: TCS ITEMS OUT OF TEMPERATURE IN COOLERS WERE PUT IN THE WALK-IN FREEZER. TCS ITEMS OUT OF TEMPERATURE ON THE LINE WERE PUT IN ICE WATER.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: OBSERVED THE FOLLOWING COOLERS/REFRIGERATORS NOT WORKING: WALK-IN COOLER, 2-DOOR-STANDING. PIC WAS AWARE OF THESE COOLERS NOT WORKING PRIOR TO INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC IS AWARE THAT NO TCS FOODS CAN BE STORED IN THE ABOVE COOLERS UNTIL THEY ARE FIXED TO HOLD FOOD AT 41F OR ABOVE. IT IS RECOMMENDED THAT THE COOLERS ARE SET AROUND 35-38F. THESE MUST BE REPAIRED TO HOLD FOOD AT 41F OR BELOW WITHIN TEN DAYS OR BY SEPTEMBER 10TH.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events. PIC could not locate vomit and diarrhea cleanup poster
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. Person in charge was provided with a spare copy of the vomit and diarrhea poster, proceeded to post in the kitchen.

violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Chicken tenders in the hot box were observed at 120F and 119F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. Person in charge reheated chicken tenders to minimum 165F ( observed 178F)

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: items in WIC - commercial yogurt cup at 47F, commercial lettuce mix at 43F, shredded cheese at 46F, commercial cream cheese serving at 50F. CFM documented proper temperature of unit at beginning of shift. EHS observed thermometer in unit reading at 50F during inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CFM immediately placed work order for WIC to be repaired. CFM moved all TCS foods to other refrigeration units. CFM will not return food to WIC until proper cold holding temperature is able to be maintained by unit. EHS recommended documenting additional TCS foods on food in equipment temperature check document.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: WIC. Observed WIC temperature at 50F during inspection. CFM recorded temperature of unit at 30F earlier in the day.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. CFM immediately placed work order for unit to be repaired. EHS will follow up with CFM to ensure unit is repaired and able to maintain proper cold holding temperature of 41F or below. Once unit is confirmed to be operational, all TCS foods may be returned to unit.
